item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Oil Prices Spike as Gulf Energy Sites Are Struck
item.summary: Airstrikes hit a major energy facility in Qatar after Tehran vowed retaliation for an earlier strike on infrastructure of the vast South Pars offshore gas field, Iran’s biggest source of natural gas.

item.title: A Lebanese Cafe on the Edge of Destruction
item.summary: Near the center of Beirut, one image captures the aftermath of an Israeli strike.

item.title: For U.S., Unmet Expectations in Iran Fit a Familiar Pattern in the Region
item.summary: Iran’s military retaliation, along with the political defiance of its new leaders, evokes a decades-old pattern of unrealized goals for American interventions in the region.

item.title: Netanyahu Hopes Strikes on Iran Will Lead to Uprising and Regime Change
item.summary: Israeli attacks have targeted the command centers of Iran’s repressive, internal security forces in hopes that Iranians will overthrow their rulers. Some see that as wishful thinking.

item.title: As Iran War Drags On, Europe Wants to Avoid a New Migration Crisis
item.summary: A decade ago, a surge in migration to Europe spurred the far-right’s rise. European leaders now fear the Iran war could set off another crisis, and they have taken tentative steps to prepare.

item.title: Empowering Iran’s Hard-liners
item.summary: U.S.-Israeli attacks helped ultraconservatives cement power. That could make ending the war tougher.

item.title: Palestinian Man Recounts Brutal Sexual Assault by Israeli Settlers
item.summary: The man said his attackers stripped him naked, beat him and zip-tied his genitalia, an account corroborated by family members and a rights activist who were also beaten.

item.title: Strikes Deliver Another Blow to Iran’s Domestic Energy Sites
item.summary: The attacks could worsen the severe electricity shortages that Iranians already face.

item.title: Iran Maintains Near-Total Internet Blackout Amid U.S.-Israeli Strikes
item.summary: As the war has stretched into its third week, the Iranian government has blocked internet access for most of its 92 million citizens.

item.title: U.S. Intelligence Saw No Change in Iran’s Missile Capabilities Before War
item.summary: On Wednesday, the director of national intelligence and C.I.A. director contradicted one of the justifications the Trump administration had given for its attacks on Iran.
